question: Who among the following received the title ‘Nur Jahan'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meherunissa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Meherunissa**, also known as **Nur Jahan**, was the wife of the Mughal Emperor Jahangir.
 
• She was originally named **Mehr-un-Nissa** before receiving the title of **Nur Jahan**, which means "Light of the World".
 
• **Nur Jahan** was not only a consort but also an influential figure in the Mughal court, often participating in administrative and political affairs.
 
• She was known for her **intellect, beauty, and strong personality**, which earned her significant power and influence.
 
• Nur Jahan was also a **patron of the arts and architecture**, commissioning several gardens, buildings, and a notable tomb for her father, Itimad-ud-Daula, in Agra.
 
• Her marriage to Jahangir was significant, as she played a vital role in the governance of the empire during his reign.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ratan Bai**__

 __
 
• **Ratan Bai** was not associated with the Mughal Empire or known by the title **Nur Jahan**.
 
 
 
• **Hamida Banu**__
 __
 
• **Hamida Banu** was the wife of Mughal Emperor Humayun and the mother of Emperor Akbar.
 
• She was also known by the title **Maryam Makani**.
 
 
 
• **Man Bai**__
 
 
• **Man Bai** was one of the wives of Mughal Emperor Jahangir and was also known as **Shah Begum**.
